description_en: Deletes a NAT firewall access control policy
description_zh: 删除NAT防火墙访问控制策略
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw delete-nat-firewall-control-policy --acl-uuid b6c8f905-2eb6-442a-ba35-9416e9dbb2c5 --nat-gateway-id ngw-xxxxxx --direction out --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteNatFirewallControlPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The language type of the response message. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the access control policy.

To delete a security access control policy, you must provide the unique ID of the policy. You can call the DescribeNatFirewallControlPolicy operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的唯一标识ID。

删除安全访问控制策略，需要提供该策略的唯一标识ID。您可调用DescribeNatFirewallControlPolicy接口获取该ID
parameters.name: acl_uuid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NAT gateway
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The direction of traffic that the access control policy controls.

Valid values:

out: outbound traffic
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略管控的流量方向。

取值：

out：流量从内到外
parameters.name: direction
